import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Map the species to a more readable format
species_map = {'setosa': 'Iris Setosa', 'versicolor': 'Iris Versicolor', 'virginica': 'Iris Virginica'}
data['species'] = data['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the sepal and petal measurements
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='sepal_length', y='petal_length', hue='species', palette='viridis', s=50)
plt.title('Sepal Length vs Petal Length by Species')
plt.xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Petal Length (cm)')
plt.legend(title='Species')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
